name: Amity University Online

about.text: Amity University has been ranked as one of the best private universities in India by the NIRF. The Amity Online University, which provides education entirely in online mode, is also a well-reputed online institution. It is known for its premium and world-class online education.

The university has been approved by UGC-DEB to offer UG, PG, and diploma-level degree courses in online mode. The online MBA program of Amity Online University has been ranked as the best in Asia by the QS Global Ranking.

The university offers online UG, PG, Certificate, and Diploma courses in the domains of Management, Information Technology, Arts & Humanities, Commerce, and Media & Journalism. There are other short-term programs as well that are trending and in demand in the industry.

about.text: The university offers 100,000+ job and placement opportunities and complete career assistance through various services and exclusive virtual job fairs in collaboration with their multiple hiring partners. The university also has collaborations with Ivy League universities to offer global exposure to its online learners.

The university has its own LMS to conduct classes and examinations and offer other immersive learning facilities. There is a facility for personalized mentorship by not just professors but also top industry leaders who assist in the portfolio building of students with the help of real-world industry projects.

aboutBoxes.title: Online Degree Acceptance
aboutBoxes.content: Online degrees earned from a government-approved university, just like a regular degree, are accepted by the top recruiters worldwide including government & private sectors.

aboutBoxes.title: Value of Online Degree
aboutBoxes.content: An online degree from a government-approved university holds similar recognition in the industry as that of a regular degree. Thus, it is equally valuable when considered for a job or higher education.

aboutBoxes.title: Quality of Education
aboutBoxes.content: The quality of education offered in online programs is of the same standard as offered in an on-campus program. Be it curriculum, faculty members, evaluation methods, practical sessions, online & on-campus programs follow similar standards of quality.

emi.text: The Amity University Online offers courses at very affordable fees. But one can also pay their academic fee through the help of easy-to-pay EMI installments. The No-cost EMI plans not only help the student to pay their whole fee in small installments but also provide them with an opportunity to finance their education. So one should definitely opt out of these education loan/EMI plans and take responsibility for their own education.

admission.text: The admission procedure for Amity Online generally takes place two times a year. The admission procedure for Amity Online generally takes place twice a year. The first admission cycle starts in January, and the second admission cycle takes place in July. The whole admission process from registration to admission confirmation takes place in online mode. No entrance exam is required for taking admission to the university.
The admission procedure for 2026 for the online courses at Amity Online University is as follows:
Step 1: Go to the official website of Amity Online (Note—there are separate websites for online and on-campus programs).
Step 2: Click on the “Apply Now” tab in the top right corner.
Step 3: First, fill in your basic personal and academic details, followed by your employment details (if any).
Step 4: Now upload all the necessary documents for eligibility proof along with your recent and colored passport-size photo.

Step 5: Submit this application form and pay the application fee. Once your application is reviewed and documents are verified, the university will inform you about your enrollment and further procedure via email.

What is the fee refund policy of Amity University Online Programs? Amity University Online refunds the course fees as per the UGC Refund Policy. A 100% refund is allowed if the admission is cancelled 15 days or more before the last admission date. A 90% refund is provided for admission cancellation less than 15 days before the last admission date. If the admission is cancelled within 15 days after the last admission date, an 80% refund will be provided. 50% if the admission is cancelled 15–30 days after the last date. No refund will be provided after 30 days, and the registration fee may not be refunded by Amity University. Click here to read the full notice.

examination.text: The examinations for all the online programs at Amity University are held through an online technology-enabled proctored mode. The exam pattern constitutes internal and external examinations. The weightage for internal (assignments) is 30% and for external (end-term examinations) is 70%. The exam comprises 3 sections—Section A (Subjective), Section B (Case Studies), and Section C (MCQs).

faqs.q: Are online programs of Amity University approved by the government?
faqs.a: Yes, Amity University is approved and entitled by the UGC to offer online courses. It is also approved by AICTE, India's first private university to be a member of the Digital Education Council.

faqs.q: Which online courses are offered by the Amity university?
faqs.a: In the UG category, Amity offers online BBA, BCA, and BA courses in several specializations. In the PG category, there are online MBA, MCA, M.Com, and MA JMC in several specializations.

faqs.q: Does Amity university have its own LMS facility?
faqs.a: Yes, Amity Online University has its own LMS with distinct features designed to provide maximum flexibility and ease of learning to the students. The daily live online classes are conducted through this LMS. All the other academic activities related to the course are done on this LMS.

faqs.q: How are examinations conducted for online degree courses?
faqs.a: The examinations for the online degree courses at Amity online university are conducted in the online mode through the LMS with remote proctoring using AI services.

faqs.q: Does Amity University offer placements for online courses?
faqs.a: Amity Online University conducts placement drives and offers placement assistance to its online learners in the form of various career support services. The university has multiple hiring partners from top companies who participate in the placement drives conducted by the university.

faqs.q: What are the top part-time courses offered by government-approved universities in India?
